name: Higa
source:
A large and strait-laced man who acts as Alma's right-hand.

This large young man wears a white tokkofuku. He has the appearance of being a bad boy in the olden days and even his speech is rough, but his current behavior is because he arrived at this school. It looks like while he was alive he used to be the complete opposite...!? He looks brusque and mean, but he's a kind person.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/05/10/bad-apple-wars/]Otome Jikan[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Higa Katsumi.[/spoiler]
